description: Write a non-destructive heal plan (.viberaven/heal-plan.md) for a specific gap or target file, to review before viberaven_heal_apply. The plan names the target and the verify command. For rls_disabled it also shows the new migration it would write and its SQL, or why it will not write one; other gaps get no patch preview. Does not modify source files.

target.description: Target file path for the heal.
